usedFor: Fathom holds meeting transcripts and Sangam CRM holds sales opportunities, so “New Transcript” can run “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript” in Fathom, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A finished meeting opens an opportunity with a follow-up date, so sales work starts from the call.

watchOut: Both “New Transcript” and “New Recording Available” can run “Create Opportunity”, so wire one to avoid two opportunities per meeting.
